summary: Comprehensive testing of Loan Given investment feature - All 11 backend tests passed. Verified create loan, add repayment, repayment status transitions, validation rules, loan detail endpoint, repayment history, and dashboard networth integration.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend InvestmentForm.js properly shows 'Loan Given' in category dropdown with conditional borrower fields (line 105, 629-760)
Frontend MyInvestments.js properly displays loan-specific card with borrowerName, outstandingAmount, loanStatus badge (line 262-289)
Frontend InvestmentDetail.js has complete Loan Given view with recovery progress bar, repayment history table, add repayment modal (lines 154-370)
Frontend Dashboard.js shows loanGivenTotal and loanGivenAtRisk in investments card when loans exist (lines 520-527)
Backend create endpoint correctly auto-initializes Loan Given fields: amountReceived=0, outstandingAmount=principal, loanStatus='active'
Backend add-repayment correctly validates: amount > 0, amount <= outstanding, updates status (active->partial->closed)
Backend detail endpoint returns loan-specific fields including repayments array, recoveryPct, borrower info
seed_data_creation: Test users created via Python driver for authenticated API testing - automatically cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Loan Given feature is fully implemented. Backend APIs working: POST /api/investments (with Loan Given category), POST /api/investments/{id}/add-repayment, GET /api/investments/{id}/detail (loan-specific), GET /api/investments/{id}/repayments, GET /api/dashboard/networth (includes loanGivenTotal/AtRisk/Count). Frontend cannot be UI tested programmatically due to Google OAuth. Code review confirms all required UI elements exist with proper data-testid attributes.
